theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the challenger with eligibility, a strong durability_bar (0.71), a clean trend hurst tag, and healthy breadth (0.857) without crowding (z 0.44). Under the trend-gate discipline, this is a theme that has staying power and is not extended, making it a reasonable overweight relative to themes blocked by the eligibility gate. The rotation structure shows it is the nearest challenger to Oil & Gas, but leadership has not handed off yet.
